notes: HOW IT WAS READ. Artificial Analysis API through the Artificial Analysis MCP tools. The key on this connection is free tier (every response says tier=free). GET /api/v2/language/models (the Pro list) returned 403 'Language models list requires a Pro subscription', so every API value here comes from GET /api/v2/language/models/free, all 4 pages of 200 (704 models, 704 unique slugs). page 1: 200 models, read 2026-10-17T06:57:54Z; page 2: 200 models, read 2026-10-17T06:58:07Z; page 3: 200 models, read 2026-10-17T06:58:07Z; page 4: 104 models, read 2026-10-17T06:58:50Z. The raw responses are saved verbatim in .cache/visual-intel/aa-free-page1..4.raw.json.

The list endpoint is unsorted and paginated; the four pages were read within a minute. Page sizes 200, 200, 200 and 104 with 704 unique slugs: none was doubled, so (if the list kept its size while being read) none was skipped either. MCP quota after the last call: 169 of 200 calls left (free tier), reset 2026-10-17T18:34:31Z.

Intelligence Index version: the API reports 4.3 (major.minor only); the API documentation says the current index is v4.3.2 with 10 evaluations (AA-Briefcase v1.1, GDPval-AA v2.1, AutomationBench-AA, Terminal-Bench 4.0, SciCode, AA-LCR v1.1, AA-Omniscience, HLE, GDP.pdf, CritPt). The evidence file also says v4.3.2. Same index.

OUTPUT TOKENS ARE NOT FROM THE API. The API's token counts (artificial_analysis_intelligence_index_token_counts) are Pro tier only. So output tokens, input tokens and tokens per task come from each variant's own public page, artificialanalysis.ai/models/<slug>, fetched with curl between 2026-10-17T07:01:36Z and 2026-10-17T07:04:53Z, field canonicalIntelligenceIndexTokenCount in the model record embedded in the page. Each variant's sources block names the URL, field and read time. Check: on every page that has the data, the embedded record's Intelligence Index, total cost, cost per task and release date equal the API values (0 mismatches across all 67), and the output-token figure agrees with the page's own visible sentence ('When evaluating the Intelligence Index, it generated 20M tokens...') within rounding.

WHAT THE COST FIGURES ARE. cost_to_run_index_usd is the API field artificial_analysis_intelligence_index_cost.total_cost: 'Total cost in USD to run the Intelligence Index evaluation', i.e. what it cost Artificial Analysis to run its full test set, in US dollars, worked out from the token prices it lists. Artificial Analysis's page calls the chart 'Cost to Run Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index' and never uses the words 'list price', so 'at list prices' is our gloss. cost_per_task_usd is the API's weighted average per test task (cost_per_task.total_cost). Prices are pricing.price_1m_input_tokens and price_1m_output_tokens, US dollars per million tokens, as Artificial Analysis lists them.

THINKING LEVEL is taken from the bracket in Artificial Analysis's own model name (Non-reasoning is recorded as 'off'; Low, Medium, High, Xhigh, Max kept as named). Two Google entries have no level in the name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite's page record gives effort 'high' (recorded, source marked); Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview gives none (left null). Anthropic's 5.5 and 5.1 entries carry 'Default Fallback' in their names; Artificial Analysis does not define it in words (the evidence checker said the same on 15 Oct).

WHAT IS IN THE FILE: 67 variants (Anthropic 25, OpenAI 35, Google 7). Every thinking level Artificial Analysis lists for each family is included, nothing interpolated. family_status says whether a family is current, the previous generation (Opus 5, kept because the task and evidence name it), or current only inside ChatGPT or the Gemini app. Nulls mean Artificial Analysis has not published the value.

Left out as superseded (data is in the raw API pages if a chart needs them): Claude Sonnet 5 (Low to Max plus Non-reasoning), Claude Fable 5 (Max only), Claude Opus 4.8 (Max only), GPT-5.6 Terra (six levels; not a ChatGPT option per the evidence), Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash (three levels each).

Artificial Analysis marks these as replaced (model page record, field deprecated, with the replacement in release.deprecatedTo): Claude Opus 5 by Claude Opus 5.5; GPT-6 Sol by GPT-6.1 Sol; GPT-5.6 Sol by GPT-6 Sol; GPT-5.6 Luna by GPT-6 Luna; Gemini 3.6 Flash by Gemini 3.7 Flash.
